name.description: Accessible name of the marker, such as "Union Station Bar, happy hour starts 8 pm". Left unset, the label is the name and the state is appended as hidden text.

state.description: The marker's state. `live` is a filled pill with a dot, `idle` an outlined pill, `selected` a raised pill with a ring, and `cluster` a round count with no tail. Defaults to `idle`.

label.description: Visible text: a start time such as "8 pm" for an idle marker, a short word for a live one, or the count for a cluster. State is never carried by colour alone.

unsupportedProps.name: icon
unsupportedProps.description: Decorative glyph drawn before the label. It is hidden from assistive technology.
